glosses: chorus (group of people in a play or performance who recite together), a choir

examples.text: Je fais partie de la chorale.
examples.en: I'm a member of the glee club.
I used to sing in the choir.

examples.text: Nous chantions dans une chorale quand nous étions enfants.
examples.en: We sang in a choir when we were kids.

examples.text: La chorale a chanté une version a capella de la chanson.
examples.en: The choir sung an a capella version of the song.

examples.text: Tom et Mary chantaient ensemble dans la chorale.
examples.en: Tom and Mary sang in the choir together.
